title: Sharp bounds for covering with large cliques and independent sets
summary: Let $n(k_1, k_2)$ be the least integer $n$ such that there exists a graph on $n$ vertices in which every vertex is contained in both a clique of size $k_1$ and an independent set of size $k_2$. Recently, Feige and Pauzner showed that ${n(k, k) \geq 4k-O(k^\frac{2}{3})}$, and conjectured that $n(k,k)=4k-4$. We prove this conjecture, and also establish the optimal lower bound in the more general case where $k_1$ and $k_2$ are arbitrary.
